confirmed_inference: Packaging opens a loop that the opening closes, so the opening owes the viewer three things: it confirms the promise the packaging made, it makes the narrator's standing visible, and it leaves a question the rest of the story answers. Enforce the first deterministically against the approved brief title, the third structurally against the beat graph, and report the second for human review rather than guessing at it.
